name: 93611 · Clovis, CA
findings: ZIP 93611 (Clovis) has 162 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93611 (Clovis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
